The reference image is the attack pose of a cartoon boss monster from a cute cat ninja tower game: an elegant long-haired white persian cat noble lady with a flat squashed face, a small golden tiara, jewelled collar, a burgundy-and-gold embroidered robe, and an enormous fluffy white tail curled around her feet like a gown. Draw the SAME character in her IDLE pose: sitting perfectly upright and composed, eyes closed in haughty disdain, chin slightly raised, the folding fan (burgundy with gold flowers) held half open in front of her mouth by one front paw, the other front paw resting demurely in her lap. Calm, still, aristocratic.
Keep the exact same character design, colours, proportions and art style as the reference - this is the same character in a calmer pose. Full body, facing LEFT like the reference, feet at the very bottom edge of the picture, fill the frame vertically.
ANATOMY RULE (most important): the cat has EXACTLY TWO front paws and two hind feet. ONE front paw holds the folding fan half open in front of her mouth; the OTHER front paw rests in her lap on the robe. No third arm, no extra paw on the ground, no duplicated limbs. Count the limbs before finishing.
Draw everything SOLID and OPAQUE - flat filled colour with soft shading. Nothing else in the picture: no ground line, no shadow, no scenery, no text, no letters, no watermark, no border.
Style: thick black outlines, flat colors with subtle soft gradients, cute cartoon look, not photorealistic.
Background must be a solid pure green (#00FF00), completely flat, for chroma keying. Nothing green on the character.
Output 1024x1024 PNG. Save the image as monster_persian_lady_idle.png in the current directory and report the path.
